en: Colorized aerial view of a mid‑20th‑century Nordic town: low apartment blocks with red roofs, scattered wooden houses, and many conifer trees. In the background stands a long, white, modernist high‑rise building dominating the skyline. A few vintage cars are visible on unpaved or newly built streets. The sky is clear and blue, and there is no printed caption or visible text on the image side.
